description.sdkfz234.blueprint.sdkfz234_: German eight-wheeled heavy armoured reconnaissance car built by Büssing-NAG from 1943. All-wheel drive and all-wheel steering give it a 90 km/h road speed; the turret mounts a 50 mm KwK 39/1 L/60 with a coaxial MG 34 behind 30 mm of frontal armour. Only 101 were built before production ended in September 1944, serving mainly with armoured reconnaissance battalions on both fronts.
